create.name: Centro Buddhista Zen Gyosho
create.bio:
Centro Buddhista Zen Gyosho is a small Soto Zen temple in Cecina, a coastal town in Tuscany south of Livorno. It was set up as a non-profit religious association in April 2013 and moved in 2019 to larger premises on Via Marrucci. For teaching and tradition it looks to Carlo Tetsugen Serra, abbot of Enso-ji in Milan and Sanboji near Berceto, whose school descends from Dogen through Harada Daiun Sogaku, a master recognised by both the Soto and Rinzai lines. The Dharma teacher Roberto Hongaku Villa guides the temple, which takes modesty and simplicity as the ground of its practice, and it belongs to the Il Cerchio network and the Italian Buddhist Union.

Group zazen runs on Monday and Friday evenings, and first-timers may join one sitting free of charge once they have booked. Over the years the centre has added afternoons for beginners, a winter open day, an evening on Zen and the martial arts, and workshops pairing sound, silence and movement led with two Italian rock musicians. Its website and YouTube channel carry Hongaku's recorded commentary on the Platform Sutra of Hui Neng, given at the temple in 2016 and 2017, along with teachings recorded during zazen and talks on the bodhisattva path and on Zen and photography.

courses.title: La pratica dello Zen – zazen il lunedì e il venerdì
courses.description: Group zazen at the Cecina temple on Monday evenings from 8 to 9 and Friday evenings from 7 to 8, open to people sitting for the first time. The first session is free, but places must be booked by phone beforehand.

free_resources.title: Conversazioni di Dharma – Il Sutra di Hui Neng
free_resources.description: A series of recorded talks by Roberto Hongaku Villa, given at the temple in 2016–17, commenting on the Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch Hui Neng and its teaching of sudden awakening.

flags: Owner said yes on 12 Nov 2026 to sister temples of Il Cerchio as own listings; none of Il Cerchio's items reused.

Site is partly stale: every event on it is past (latest 5 Jul 2026), several practice pages date from 2020–21 (Zen itinerante 'suspended', 'pratiche correlate' for 2021). Only the weekly zazen page reads as current.
Videos are older (2020–21) talks from its own channel; most recent upload April 2024. Channel has 22 subscribers.

Health rule: the site has a Zen Shiatsu page, and two gallery photos show shiatsu at a fair stand; all left out. The 'Colloqui individuali' page offers pandemic-era listening support described as psychological help; left out.
Photo 2 (20180129_164849) predates the 2019 move to Via Marrucci, so it may show the earlier premises; photo 1 is from 2021. Photo 3 is the channel's logo avatar (yt3.ggpht.com).
The home page also shows a mistyped mailto (segreteria@centrogyosho.itm); the correct address segreteria@centrogyosho.it is used. No contact form (newsletter form only).
Roberto Hongaku Villa and Tetsugen Serra are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty.
Regional: Cecina (Livorno province, Tuscany), a town of about 28,000.
Sound workshops were run with Livio Magnini (Bluvertigo) and Luca Vicini (Subsonica); the bio says 'two Italian rock musicians' without naming them.
